titulo: Nvidia board reportedly meets to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s future as chip giant’s share price plunges – follow live
cuerpo: Nvidia shares fall in pre-market trading after report of Huang’s second affair Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang Too big – and too well-connected – to sack? Huang does not enjoy the supercharged voting rights that are par for the course elsewhere – his shareholding is a plain vanilla 3.6%. On the other hand, Nvidia’s board does not appear to have spent much time worrying about succession planning and “key person risk” or other standard concerns of corporate governance wonks outside the US.
